# spire — SPIRE Server API

[All groups](README.md)

## spire info

Ask a SPIRE server about itself: health, uptime, entry and agent counts, its own SVID chain, the active, prepared and old X.509 and JWT authorities, and its trust bundle, with checks on expiry and rotation.

MCP tool: `spire_info`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spire bundles

The SPIRE server's trust bundle and the federated bundles it holds, each authority checked (validity, tainted, expired JWT keys), and its federation relationships (bundle endpoint URL and profile, whether a bundle was fetched).

MCP tool: `spire_bundles`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spire entries

List or look up SPIRE registration entries (by ID, SPIFFE ID, parent ID, selectors or hint) and check them: in the trust domain, parent is the server, an agent or another entry, not expired, X509-SVID TTL at most 24h, admin entries named.

MCP tool: `spire_entries`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--id` | string | One entry by its ID. |
| `--spiffe-id` | string | Entries for this SPIFFE ID. |
| `--parent-id` | string | Entries with this parent (an agent's ID, or the server's for node entries). |
| `--selectors` | list | Entries with these selectors, type:value (e.g. unix:uid:1000). |
| `--match` | string | How selectors match. Default `superset`. One of `exact`, `subset`, `superset`, `any`. |
| `--hint` | string | Entries with this hint. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spire agents

List the agents a SPIRE server has attested: SPIFFE ID, attestation type, selectors, SVID expiry, banned, whether it can re-attest, version; warns about agents whose SVID has expired.

MCP tool: `spire_agents`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--attestation-type` | string | Only agents attested this way (join_token, k8s_psat, aws_iid...) |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spire mint

Have a SPIRE server mint an X509-SVID (for a key idpdbg makes, returned with it) or a JWT-SVID for any SPIFFE ID in its trust domain, and check it against the specifications and the server's bundle. Needs administrator access.

MCP tool: `spire_mint`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--spiffe-id` | string | The SPIFFE ID to mint for. **Required.** |
| `--type` | string | X509-SVID or JWT-SVID. Default `x509`. One of `x509`, `jwt`. |
| `--audience` | list | JWT-SVID audiences (required for jwt). |
| `--ttl` | int | Lifetime in seconds (default: the server's). |
| `--dns-names` | list | X509-SVID DNS names. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spire entry_create

Create a SPIRE registration entry: which workloads (selectors, under a parent agent) get which SPIFFE ID, with optional TTLs, DNS names, federation, admin and downstream flags.

MCP tool: `spire_entry_create`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--spiffe-id` | string | The SPIFFE ID workloads get. **Required.** |
| `--parent-id` | string | The agent (or node alias) the workloads run under; spiffe://&lt;td&gt;/spire/server for a node entry. **Required.** |
| `--selectors` | list | type:value selectors, e.g. unix:uid:1000 or k8s:ns:prod. **Required.** |
| `--x509-svid-ttl` | int | X509-SVID lifetime in seconds (default: the server's). |
| `--jwt-svid-ttl` | int | JWT-SVID lifetime in seconds (default: the server's). |
| `--dns-names` | list | DNS names for the X509-SVIDs. |
| `--federates-with` | list | Trust domains whose bundles the workloads also get. |
| `--admin` | bool | Workloads with this ID may use the whole server API. |
| `--downstream` | bool | Workloads with this ID may run a downstream SPIRE server (get an intermediate CA). |
| `--hint` | string | Hint for workloads with several SVIDs. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spire entry_delete

Delete SPIRE registration entries by ID; the workloads lose those SVIDs when they expire.

MCP tool: `spire_entry_delete`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--ids` | list | Entry IDs (from spire.entries). **Required.** |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spire join_token

Create a join token an agent attests with (join_token node attestor), optionally with a node alias SPIFFE ID for the agent.

MCP tool: `spire_join_token`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | The server's admin Unix socket (default /tmp/spire-server/private/api.sock); the caller is an administrator. |
| `--server` | string | Instead of the socket: the server API over TCP with mTLS, host:port (default port 8081). |
| `--svid` | string | Over TCP: the client X509-SVID (PEM chain) whose SPIFFE ID is in the server's admin_ids. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--svid-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--workload-socket` | string | Over TCP: take the client SVID and the bundle from this Workload API (a SPIRE agent) instead. |
| `--trust-domain` | string | The server's trust domain (default: the client SVID's). |
| `--bundle` | string | Over TCP: the trust domain's X.509 authorities to verify the server with (PEM or a SPIFFE bundle). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--ttl` | int | Lifetime in seconds. Default `600`. |
| `--agent-id` | string | Also give the agent this SPIFFE ID (a node alias entry). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
